verses.he: פַּלְגֵי־מַ֣יִם לֶב־מֶ֭לֶךְ בְּיַד־יְהוָ֑ה עַֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יַחְפֹּ֣ץ יַטֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the watercourses: He turneth it whithersoever He will.

verses.he: כָּֽל־דֶּרֶךְ־אִ֭ישׁ יָשָׁ֣ר בְּעֵינָ֑יו וְתֹכֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes; But the LORD weigheth the hearts.

verses.he: עֲ֭שֹׂה צְדָקָ֣ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט נִבְחָ֖ר לַיהוָ֣ה מִזָּֽבַח׃
verses.en: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

verses.he: רוּם־עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַב־לֵ֑ב נִ֖ר רְשָׁעִ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.en: A haughty look, and a proud heart— The tillage of the wicked is sin.

verses.he: מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת חָ֭רוּץ אַךְ־לְמוֹתָ֑ר וְכָל־אָ֝֗ץ אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; But every one that is hasty hasteth only to want.

verses.he: פֹּ֣עַל א֭וֹצָרוֹת בִּלְשׁ֣וֹן שָׁ֑קֶר הֶ֥בֶל נִ֝דָּ֗ף מְבַקְשֵׁי־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue Is a vapour driven to and fro; they [that seek them] seek death.

verses.he: שֹׁד־רְשָׁעִ֥ים יְגוֹרֵ֑ם כִּ֥י מֵ֝אֲנ֗וּ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.en: The violence of the wicked shall drag them away; Because they refuse to do justly.

verses.he: הֲפַכְפַּ֬ךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ אִ֣ישׁ וָזָ֑ר וְ֝זַ֗ךְ יָשָׁ֥ר פָּעֳלֽוֹ׃
verses.en: The way of man is froward and strange; But as for the pure, his work is right.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב לָשֶׁ֥בֶת עַל־פִּנַּת־גָּ֑ג מֵאֵ֥שֶׁת מִ֝דְיָנִ֗ים וּבֵ֥ית חָֽבֶר׃
verses.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, Than in a house in common with a contentious woman.

verses.he: נֶ֣פֶשׁ רָ֭שָׁע אִוְּתָה־רָ֑ע לֹא־יֻחַ֖ן בְּעֵינָ֣יו רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil; His neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.

verses.he: בַּעְנָשׁ־לֵ֭ץ יֶחְכַּם־פֶּ֑תִי וּבְהַשְׂכִּ֥יל לְ֝חָכָ֗ם יִקַּח־דָּֽעַת׃
verses.en: When the scorner is punished, the thoughtless is made wise; And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.

verses.he: מַשְׂכִּ֣יל צַ֭דִּיק לְבֵ֣ית רָשָׁ֑ע מְסַלֵּ֖ף רְשָׁעִ֣ים לָרָֽע׃
verses.en: The Righteous One considereth the house of the wicked; Overthrowing the wicked to their ruin.

verses.he: אֹטֵ֣ם אָ֭זְנוֹ מִזַּעֲקַת־דָּ֑ל גַּֽם־ה֥וּא יִ֝קְרָ֗א וְלֹ֣א יֵעָנֶֽה׃
verses.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, He also shall cry himself, but shall not be answered.

verses.he: מַתָּ֣ן בַּ֭סֵּתֶר יִכְפֶּה־אָ֑ף וְשֹׁ֥חַד בַּ֝חֵ֗ק חֵמָ֥ה עַזָּֽה׃
verses.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger, And a present in the bosom strong wrath.

verses.he: שִׂמְחָ֣ה לַ֭צַּדִּיק עֲשׂ֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מְחִתָּ֗ה לְפֹ֣עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.en: To do justly is joy to the righteous, But ruin to the workers of iniquity.

verses.he: אָדָ֗ם תּ֭וֹעֶה מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשְׂכֵּ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל רְפָאִ֣ים יָנֽוּחַ׃
verses.en: The man that strayeth out of the way of understanding Shall rest in the congregation of the shades.

verses.he: אִ֣ישׁ מַ֭חְסוֹר אֹהֵ֣ב שִׂמְחָ֑ה אֹהֵ֥ב יַֽיִן־וָ֝שֶׁ֗מֶן לֹ֣א יַעֲשִֽׁיר׃
verses.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man; He that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

verses.he: כֹּ֣פֶר לַצַּדִּ֣יק רָשָׁ֑ע וְתַ֖חַת יְשָׁרִ֣ים בּוֹגֵֽד׃
verses.en: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous; And the faithless cometh in the stead of the upright.

verses.he: ט֗וֹב שֶׁ֥בֶת בְּאֶֽרֶץ־מִדְבָּ֑ר מֵאֵ֖שֶׁת מדונים [מִדְיָנִ֣ים] וָכָֽעַס׃
verses.en: It is better to dwell in a desert land, Than with a contentious and fretful woman.

verses.he: אוֹצָ֤ר׀ נֶחְמָ֣ד וָ֭שֶׁמֶן בִּנְוֵ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וּכְסִ֖יל אָדָ֣ם יְבַלְּעֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: There is desirable treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise; But a foolish man swalloweth it up.

verses.he: רֹ֭דֵף צְדָקָ֣ה וָחָ֑סֶד יִמְצָ֥א חַ֝יִּ֗ים צְדָקָ֥ה וְכָבֽוֹד׃
verses.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy Findeth life, prosperity, and honour.

verses.he: עִ֣יר גִּ֭בֹּרִים עָלָ֣ה חָכָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗רֶד עֹ֣ז מִבְטֶחָֽה׃
verses.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, And bringeth down the stronghold wherein it trusteth.

verses.he: שֹׁמֵ֣ר פִּ֭יו וּלְשׁוֹנ֑וֹ שֹׁמֵ֖ר מִצָּר֣וֹת נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue Keepeth his soul from troubles.

verses.he: זֵ֣ד יָ֭הִיר לֵ֣ץ שְׁמ֑וֹ ע֝וֹשֶׂ֗ה בְּעֶבְרַ֥ת זָדֽוֹן׃
verses.en: A proud and haughty man, scorner is his name, Even he that dealeth in overbearing pride.

verses.he: תַּאֲוַ֣ת עָצֵ֣ל תְּמִיתֶ֑נּוּ כִּֽי־מֵאֲנ֖וּ יָדָ֣יו לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; For his hands refuse to labour.

verses.he: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם הִתְאַוָּ֣ה תַאֲוָ֑ה וְצַדִּ֥יק יִ֝תֵּ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַחְשֹֽׂךְ׃
verses.en: There is that coveteth greedily all the day long; But the righteous giveth and spareth not.

verses.he: זֶ֣בַח רְ֭שָׁעִים תּוֹעֵבָ֑ה אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־בְזִמָּ֥ה יְבִיאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; How much more, when he bringeth it with the proceeds of wickedness?

verses.he: עֵד־כְּזָבִ֥ים יֹאבֵ֑ד וְאִ֥ישׁ שׁ֝וֹמֵ֗עַ לָנֶ֥צַח יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.en: A false witness shall perish; But the man that obeyeth shall speak unchallenged.

verses.he: הֵעֵ֬ז אִ֣ישׁ רָשָׁ֣ע בְּפָנָ֑יו וְ֝יָשָׁ֗ר ה֤וּא׀ יכין דרכיו [יָבִ֬ין דַּרְכּֽוֹ]׃
verses.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face; But as for the upright, he looketh well to his way.

verses.he: אֵ֣ין חָ֭כְמָה וְאֵ֣ין תְּבוּנָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין עֵ֝צָ֗ה לְנֶ֣גֶד יְהוָֽה׃
verses.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding Nor counsel against the LORD.

verses.he: ס֗וּס מ֭וּכָן לְי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ֝לַֽיהוָ֗ה הַתְּשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle; But victory is of the LORD.
